## Key Extracted Findings

IEA Global EV Outlook 2025 is the primary market anchor for this ingest. It reports that energy-sector battery demand reached 1 TWh in 2024, with EV batteries over 950 GWh and electric cars accounting for most EV battery demand.

IEA describes LFP as nearly half of global EV battery sales in 2024 and almost 30% cheaper per kWh than NMC. NMC retains higher energy density and remains more common in the United States and Europe.

IEA identifies advanced battery technologies including solid-state, sodium-ion, lithium-sulfur, iron-air, and redox-flow, while distinguishing EV-relevant high-energy technologies from grid-oriented technologies.

IEA cautions that solid-state advantages still need pack-scale validation under realistic standardized conditions and that early "solid-state" products may actually be semi-solid or quasi-solid systems.

## Project Use

Use this source as the baseline for market share, chemistry comparison, and commercialization caution. Use company announcements as technology-specific signals, but compare them against IEA's readiness framing.
